name: io.github.Nikoble1926/kraken-signals-mcp
description: Free BTC/USD signal preview plus pay-per-call (USDC on Base via x402) crypto trading signals, market regime, history, backtest and TA indicators from the Kraken Crypto Signals API.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Base wallet private key (0x...) for a low-balance hot wallet holding a little USDC. Required only for the paid tools; the free get_signal_preview tool works without it. Never use your main wallet.

environmentVariables.name: RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the signals API base URL. Defaults to https://signals.nsgoods.org.
